a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first almost guarantees we both fail, since we'd need about 3 storm-free rounds. So I'm proposing we change it, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. Afterward I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather take now instead, tell me and we can settle who goes first.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because of the storm risk. I won't take anything more. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you.
